spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the exact gate the proposal modifies — activation-gated window.open with expiry (~5s) and consumption — plus the live navigator.userActivation surface; the page explicitly quotes the one-line rule change the delegated token adds.

interactive.rationale: Four buttons each perform the real window.open call and log the genuine WindowProxy/null return; a 250ms meter shows isActive/hasBeenActive flipping with real interactions.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises the real activation behaviours and the live readout; all delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Expiry, consumption, popup-allowlist/user-setting variance (logged explicitly when a delayed or second open unexpectedly succeeds) and cleanup (close-all) are all handled.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5091965583622144 and the HTML transient-activation definition.

conformance.rationale: Backs the suite's user-activation-model-exposed assertion and gives the manual popup assertions their observable baseline.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (Playwright CDP): all buttons exercised at both viewports, meters live, popups really opened and were closed, console clean, 0px overflow after fixing a real 39px mobile overflow (unbreakable H2 token) found by measurement. However this headless environment does not enforce the popup blocker (even with Playwright's --disable-popup-blocking removed), so the BLOCKED branches (delayed/second open) could not be observed here — the page logs that condition honestly; blocked outcomes need a real desktop Chrome with default settings.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the with-activation open; delayed/double arms record observed outcomes with the default-settings expectation in details, and double-open fails only on the incoherent second-only-opens shape — avoiding false alarms from users with popup allowlists.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons pair background/color; meter on/off states use emerald-dark/rose on ivory.

accessibility.rationale: role=log live region for outcomes (meters deliberately aria-live=off to avoid announcement spam, with outcomes announced via the log), labelled buttons, focus-visible outlines.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800 after the overflow fix: meters stack to one column, 0px overflow, 44px buttons; both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Capture the blocked branches on a real desktop Chrome
openQuestions.detail: The headless shell used for verification permits all window.open calls, so experiments 2 and 3's expected BLOCKED outcomes were not observable (the page logs the discrepancy honestly). On a desktop Chrome with default popup settings, verify: delayed open returns null, double-open second call returns null, and the log/telemetry record them.

guidanceConsulted.query: live region frequency rapid updates aria-live off
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Do not put rapidly-changing values in announced live regions; announce discrete outcomes instead.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The 4-per-second activation meters are aria-live=off; the role=log region announces each experiment's outcome once.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive stat tiles grid without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Ensure long unbreakable tokens wrap and grids collapse on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Found a real 39px overflow from the 'navigator.userActivation,' H2 token at 360px; fixed with overflow-wrap:anywhere and an explicit single-column meter breakpoint, re-measured 0px.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: diag run: initial overflow=39 → none after fix

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep popup creation tied to explicit user intent, one gesture one popup.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The page's experiments demonstrate exactly that invariant and the copy ties it to the delegation's 1:1 token rule.

summary: The fully-real foundation concept: activation-gated window.open with live userActivation meters, expiry and consumption experiments, and honest logging when the environment's popup settings change the outcome. A genuine mobile overflow was found and fixed during verification; blocked branches need a default-settings desktop Chrome and are flagged as the open question.
